script_text: Stop scrolling! Virgo, this week the cosmos speaks. Monday: Mercury trine Jupiter fuels clear communication—perfect for writing contracts or sending that long‑overdue email. Take decisive action. Tuesday: Venus squares Saturn warns against over‑committing in love; set boundaries, keep plans simple. Wednesday: Mars opposes Neptune clouds motivation—avoid starting new projects, focus on finishing existing tasks. Thursday: Sun sextile Pluto empowers deep self‑reflection; journal your goals and release old patterns. Friday: Jupiter conjunct Uranus sparks sudden opportunities in learning—sign up for a workshop or online course. Saturday: Saturn trine Mercury stabilizes finances; review budget, pay off a small debt. Sunday: Moon in Taurus soothes nerves; practice grounding meditation. Best day: Friday for breakthroughs in growth. Worst day: Wednesday, when foggy energy can cause missteps. Advice: align actions with planetary flow, stay adaptable, and trust your inner wisdom. Remember, Virgo, your patience today will shape tomorrow’s success brightly.
